name: date_bin_on_boundaries
query: SELECT DISTINCT date_bin('1 month', 2000-02-01, 2000-01-01) AS feb, date_bin(interval('1 month'), 2000-03-01, 2000-01-01) AS mar, date_bin('3 months', 2015-07-01, 2015-01-01) AS q3, date_bin('1 year', 2016-01-01, 2015-01-01) AS next_year, date_bin('1 month', 2015-01-01, 2015-01-01) AS origin, date_bin('1 month', 2014-12-01, 2015-01-01) AS month_before, date_bin('1 month', 2014-11-30, 2015-01-01) AS before, date_bin('7 days', 2015-01-12, 2015-01-05) AS week WHERE account = 'Expenses:Financial:Fees'
notes: ACCEPTED DEVIATION: with a stride of months or years, beanquery puts a date exactly on a bin boundary other than the origin into the previous bin (date_bin('1 month', 2000-02-01, 2000-01-01) is 2000-01-01), while a stride of days starts a new bin there. In zhang a date on a boundary always starts its bin (2000-02-01), as date_trunc() does.
